title: trifolium hirsutum var. pictum
intro: Trifolium hirsutum var. pictum, commonly known as painted clover, is a variety of clover plant that is characterized by its striking appearance, featuring a mix of white and pink flowers. The plant is rich in nutrients and has been used for its various health benefits, including its ability to support the immune system, reduce inflammation, and act as an antioxidant. Therapeutically, painted clover has been used to treat various conditions, including fever, cough, and skin issues, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of painted clover include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions.
